item.title: 6/23: The Takeout: Gene Sperling
item.description: Senior adviser to President Biden Gene Sperling talks about the causes of inflation and possible solutions, economic perceptions versus reality and how the economy factors into the upcoming election.

item.title: 7/14: The Takeout: Democratic Rep. Adam Smith
item.description: For this edition of "The Takeout," Major Garrett sits down with Rep. Adam Smith of Washington, who is one of several House Democrats to publicly call for President Biden to drop out of the 2024 race. Smith discusses the need for a new candidate, and how Vice President Kamala Harris could steer American optimism in a positive direction.

item.title: 7/28: The Takeout: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
item.description: Independent candidate for president Robert F. Kennedy Jr. discusses the state of the race, Kamala Harris' likely Democratic nomination, and his role during a historic election cycle.

item.title: 3/31: The Takeout: Filmmaker Brian Knappenberger
item.description: For this edition of "The Takeout," Major Garrett speaks to filmmaker Brian Knappenberger about directing the nine-part documentary series, "Turning Point: The Bomb and the Cold War." The Netflix series offers a comprehensive look at the Cold War and its aftermath. Knappenberger says the aim of his documentary was to reflect and to also explore present-day tensions.

item.title: 4/28: The Takeout: Ali Zaidi
item.description: White House Climate Advisor Ali Zaidi joins Major Garrett to discuss the current state of climate policy, electric versus hybrid vehicles, and the role the U.S. plays in the conversation about global climate solutions.

item.title: 1/19: The Takeout: Author and historian H.W. Brands
item.description: Author and historian H.W. Brands joins "The Takeout" to talk about the spread of propaganda during World War II to gain support for American intervention, the anti-intervention movement led by Charles Lindbergh, and how FDR and Winston Churchill used the global media to influence each other and the world.

item.title: 1/12: The Takeout: Jonathan Alter
item.description: Jonathan Alter, author of a biography of former President Jimmy Carter, joins Major Garrett to talk about Carter's life and legacy, the principles that guided Carter in the White House and his foresight on future environmental issues.

item.title: 1/5: The Takeout: Arthur C. Brooks
item.description: Author Arthur C. Brooks joins The Takeout podcast to discuss happiness and his behavioral science research on finding happiness, purpose in life and human emotions. Brooks and Major Garrett also discuss the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on human behavior and the one group which emerged better from lockdown.

item.title: Sneak peek: Kiss of Death and the Google Exec
item.description: The mysterious death of a Google executive and his last night with an exotic beauty captured on video -- now a court decides her fate. "48 Hours" correspondent Maureen Maher reports Saturday, August 30 at 9/8c on CBS and streaming on Paramount+.

item.title: Seahawks ride their stifling defense to dominant Super Bowl win over the Patriots
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks defeated the New England Patriots Sunday to win the 2026 Super Bowl.
